n: 30 In. Stainless Steel Over The Range Convection Microwave Oven With Modern Handle
desc: Luxury isn’t meant to be desired - it’s meant to be attainable. Inspired by Lake Tahoe, USA, the ZLINE 30 in. Stainless Steel Over the Range Convection Microwave Oven with Modern Handle (MWO-OTR-30) provides a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: Enjoy up to a 300 CFM air flow that effectively removes unwanted smoke and grease from your kitchen - configurable for either recirculating or external ducting
Select from a variety of convection and microwave cooking settings to provide optimal dish results
Easy One-Touch controls allow you to quickly heat your favorite snacks and dishes
A unique stainless steel interior is engineered to scatter microwaves to ensure even cooking and prevent any cold spots
Easily illuminate your cooking space with 2 built-in lights
Durable glass turntable provides an even heat distribution with every use
